name: Scapular Fracture
definition: Fracture of the scapula, usually associated with high-energy trauma and sometimes accompanied by chest, clavicle or neurovascular injuries.

investigations.principle: Radiographs are initial; CT is important for glenoid, neck and complex fracture planning.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when soft-tissue, neural, marrow, occult injury, infection or other condition-specific questions require it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific imaging pathway.

green: Sling and early guided motion for suitable stable fractures
amber: Displaced glenoid or unstable shoulder-girdle injuries require specialist surgical assessment.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Amsa-bhagna principles may complement rehabilitation after orthopedic stabilization.

patientEducation.summary: Fracture of the scapula, usually associated with high-energy trauma and sometimes accompanied by chest, clavicle or neurovascular injuries.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for major trauma, acute/progressive neurological deficit, severe infection/systemic illness, vascular compromise or other listed red flags.
